_readme: Registry of external reference datasets for the SPRING Environmental Impact Engine. status='not_connected' means SPRING has NOT fetched or cached any real numbers from that source yet — this sandbox has no outbound network access, so nothing here was actually called. Before flipping a source to 'connected', someone with network access must (1) confirm the endpoint below is still current, (2) confirm the license permits this use, (3) fetch and store a dated snapshot under data/reference-cache/, and (4) fill in geographic_coverage/temporal_coverage/units/indicators from the real response. Never hand-fill placeholder numbers into a 'connected' source.

sources.name: FAO AQUASTAT
sources.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
sources.api_endpoint: https://data.apps.fao.org/aquastat/api/v1/ (FAO AQUASTAT Data API — confirm current path at fao.org/aquastat before use)
sources.authentication: None publicly documented for read access as of this registry's creation; verify current terms
sources.rate_limits: unknown — verify in current API docs
sources.license: FAO data license — verify redistribution terms before caching publicly
